sources.caveat: The most doctrinally live source in the corpus and the one least visible to any local check. Sam edits posts in place — #1095 and #1613 both show "last edited" — so a quote can drift with no commit anywhere. Snapshotting (refresh/snapshot-discussions.py) is what makes those quotes re-verifiable. Watch BOTH vocabularies for a topic: "presentation registry" misses #1095, which invents the idea under the name "issuee usage registry".
